chapter.heading: Joel 3
The LORD Judges the Nations
chapter.v: “ For behold ,in those days and at that time , when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem ,

I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat . AndI will enter into judgment with them there , on behalf of my people and my heritage Israel , because they have scattered them among the nations and have divided up my land ,
andhave cast lots for my people , and have traded a boy for a prostitute , and have sold a girl for wine and have drunk it .

“ What are you to me ,O Tyre and Sidon , and allthe regions of Philistia ? Are you paying me back for something ? If you are paying me back ,I will return your payment on your own head swiftly and speedily .
Foryou have taken my silver and my gold , and have carried my rich treasures into your temples .
You have soldthe people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their own border .
Behold , I will stir them up from the place to which you have sold them , andI will return your payment on your own head .
I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the people of Judah , and they will sell them to theSabeans , to a nation far away , for the Lord has spoken . ”

all the surrounding nations .
for their evil is great .
in the valley of decision .
and the stars withdraw their shining .
